content: Hello, I am Meridian Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alexis Dale?
No, this isn't Alexis. I'm the office manager and usually handle their paperwork, so how can I help?
I can discuss this with Mx Dale alone. When can Mx Dale be reached?
That's fine, I understand. Alexis will be available tomorrow at 10:00 if you can call back then.
Your callback is booked. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
